summary: Held through a strong favorable run (peaked +46, later +45.5 again) and through normal giveback/dip cycles up to ~44% giveback since price kept recovering to new local highs. Bailed at t=10m once price round-tripped the entire gain in two consecutive bars (+45.5 -> -1.5 -> -21.75) with KMDR/HA/PROPP all firing against and no recovery bar in between -- that acceleration through breakeven into a growing negative, rather than a bounce off a dip, was the wrong-direction signature. Next time I'd watch for the same pattern earlier: a full round-trip of a multi-bar leg's gain within 1-2 bars plus unanimous against-fires is a much stronger tell than giveback% alone, since giveback% stayed noisy (bouncing 9%-64%) throughout the good part of the trade.
